name: Atlantic to Atlas 2027
disclaimer: Inspired by the 2027 Dakar route. Unofficial, not affiliated.
description: A full-length rally raid from the Algarve across Morocco to the far south and back to Marrakech: a prologue, twelve days of racing, one transfer with a sea crossing, a rest day and a two-day marathon. Bivouac towns, stage order and stage distances follow the published route; every special-stage line is our own, generated by rally.raid Earth Stage-Gen on OpenStreetMap data.
region: Portugal, Morocco and the Saharan south
dataSource: Stage lines: rally.raid Earth Stage-Gen on OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), Mapterhorn terrain, ESA WorldCover 2021 (CC BY 4.0). Route facts (towns, dates, distances): Published stage-by-stage route (bivouac towns, dates, total and special-stage km), FIM news 30 Oct 2026: https://www.fim-moto.com/en/news/news-detail/article/portugal-and-morocco-to-exceptionally-host-the-49th-edition

source.facts: Published stage-by-stage route (bivouac towns, dates, total and special-stage km), FIM news 30 Oct 2026: https://www.fim-moto.com/en/news/news-detail/article/portugal-and-morocco-to-exceptionally-host-the-49th-edition
source.notUsed: No official stage lines, roadbooks, maps or descriptions were copied. Liaison in/out splits are our estimates (only the day totals are published). The refuge camp position is invented (not published).

rules.teleport: A teleported liaison counts its full allowance as elapsed time.
rules.bivouac: Allowance not used on liaisons that day is added to the evening bivouac repair time (repairConfig.lua rally section).
rules.marathon: Marathon days: no assistance at the refuge; the bivouac repair is limited (repairConfig.lua rally.marathon).
rules.lateMin: Arriving after the allowance: rally.latePenaltyPerMinS seconds per started minute late (repairConfig.lua).
